questions.q: Which three approaches does the summary say can create a new market?
a: Disruption, non-disruptive creation, and redefining a problem
Cost cutting, outsourcing, and franchising
Imitation, acquisition, and price wars
Segmentation, bundling, and upselling
questions.why: The first lesson groups blue ocean moves into these three strategies.

questions.q: What does the ActiFry example show about creating a blue ocean?
a: Reframing an existing problem can open a new market
New technology always defeats an older industry
Solving an entirely new problem is the only route
Copying a successful product guarantees growth
questions.why: Groupe SEB redefined french fries as something that need not be deep fried.

questions.q: What is the buyer utility map used for?
a: Finding where customers struggle across their experience
Plotting competitors' prices and market share
Tracking employee productivity over time
Forecasting the total size of a market
questions.why: The map crosses buyer experience stages with utility levers to expose pain points.

questions.q: What did citizenM eliminate to make hotel check-in easier?
a: Concierge and front desk services
Room service and minibars
Gyms and swimming pools
Breakfast buffets and parking
questions.why: Guests no longer wait in line, and ambassadors handle questions instead.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the four actions framework?
a: To test which industry factors to eliminate, reduce, raise or create
To rank employees by productivity and initiative
To choose which countries to expand into first
To set prices lower than every competitor
questions.why: The framework helps a company reshape its offering rather than copy rivals.
